behaviors.description: Read real bundle payloads and retain owned results.
behaviors.preconditions: Reference-exported bundles with and without URLs, distinct 64/128 PNGs, compressed XML and metadata.
behaviors.expected: Identity, commit, file, metadata, XML, size, icons and URLs match; owned file, bytes and origin survive bundle destruction.

behaviors.description: Reject malformed and missing public bundle files.
behaviors.preconditions: Literal invalid bytes and nonexistent path; unrelated runtime installed.
behaviors.expected: Bundle constructor and direct installer fail with GError; transaction fails either when adding or running; app remains absent and runtime unchanged.

mappings.rationale: Actual bundles assert all payload fields against independent inputs, both optional URL cases and retained transfer-full results after destruction.
Public bundle failure cases have no matching behavior row in the fixed denominator.
